text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! They want me to be the
teller for the
Fleetfoot Festival?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Fleetfoot Festival is held each
fall to
pray for the safety of all
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We'd like you to deliver the formal
opening for
the festival—the Ode to
Umamusume of Yore.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's a formal openin', I'll have to
try and
speak properly, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do it! But ya gotta go on
stage with
me, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You wish for me to join you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall endeavor to support
you in any
way I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Inari One and Yaeno Muteki
agree to
recite the Ode to Umamusume
of Yore together
at the Fleetfoot
Festival.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"There once was an Umamusume born of
the
distant sea who emerged from sands
and coral, a
daughter of the reef."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And of the sea she was, for even as she
left the
ocean and ran through golden
fields of wheat, did
she appear as raging
waves."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Behold, I am the child of the reef who
grinds
down wheat with her heel! I am
the descendant of
noble millers past!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Inari One recites, Yaeno Muteki
acts on the
stage. They make a pretty
good team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the story isn't the most riveting thing
in the
world, and the audience is barely
listening. That
is, until...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"But lo! It was then that rivals appeared
to
challenge her speed!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Unwillin' to lose, she shot forth with a
big ol'
burst o' speed!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wha... Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"She sprinted toward the hill and flew
over it just
as fast! In the blink of an eye,
she'd left all the
other Umamusume in
her dust!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She's... more or less... telling the story as
it's
written, but her personality is
slipping through...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"The child of the reef was transformed
into a
fleet-footed goddess! 'I'll take
over America!' she
declared, as she flew
to the front of the pack!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You're doing great, Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's manner of speech suddenly
changes,
and at the exact same moment,
the crowd seems
to come alive.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"She let out a victorious yell—but that's
when it
all came crashin' down!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"The moment she reached the very front,
she
heard a gut-wrenchin' sound by her
feet—the
harbinger of the end..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And thus the fleet-footed goddess, who
ran
'cross a faraway island country,
faded like the
fields after the harvest,
never to run again..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Not! As if things'd actually end that
way! She
said, 'Even if I can't run on my
own two feet...'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"'I'll run all over this country on
millstones! In fact,
what's stoppin' me
from spreadin' that style of
runnin' all
over the world?'"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Hit it, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki manages to go with the
flow,
matching Inari One's impromptu
narration and
brings the performance to
a beautiful end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd is on their feet, still
applauding at
their grand success of a
show.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I was worried that wouldn't go
well, but
you certainly got the crowd
excited, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I sure did! Everyone would've fallen
dead asleep if
I hadn't spiced things up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What'd ya think of our performance,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Izzat so? Well, traditional storytellin's
fallen
pretty hard by the wayside
nowadays.
choice_data_list: The Umamusume's feelings really came through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she mentions it, the way Inari
One told
her story today really felt like
how tales were
traditionally told in Edo.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Since the crowd was already driftin' off, I
just
decided to go for it and riff off some
improv
lines, but things actually worked
out pretty great!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazin' how artists and
entertainers can
make stuff outta
nothin'?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Your style of speech and
narration
certainly helped, but the way
you told the story
of how the
Umamusume of eld used to live...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I think that really touched the crowd's
heart. You
were incredible, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Inari One's unique style of
recitation,
the night of the Fleetfoot
Festival is made all the
more exciting.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Really? So I was able to put everyone in
the
fleet-footed goddess's shoes, huh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I sure hope so. Speaking for myself, I felt
as
though I was imbued with the spirits
of our
ancestors.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. Our performance was
significantly
different from its original
telling, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It kinda felt like she really did act the
way I said
she did, eh? All bluster and
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right! Our openin' was a grand
success, and
we've set the mood for this
party! I'm not gonna
rest till I nail the
role of the Heartfire Bearer next!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This festival's just gettin' started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One rides the high from her
performance
through the rest of the
night, running about the
festival and
making merry with everyone.
